from PIL import Image, ImageEnhance
import numpy as np
im = Image.open('radiograph.jpg').convert('L')

def local_eq(a, radius=40):
    # simple local contrast: subtract heavy blur, rescale
    from PIL import ImageFilter
    p = Image.fromarray(a)
    blur = p.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(radius))
    la = np.asarray(blur).astype(np.float32)
    out = a.astype(np.float32) - la + 128
    out = np.clip(out, 0, 255).astype(np.uint8)
    return out

def closeup(name, x1, y1, x2, y2, scale=5):
    c = im.crop((x1,y1,x2,y2))
    a = np.asarray(c).astype(np.uint8)
    a = local_eq(a)
    c = Image.fromarray(a)
    c = c.resize((c.width*scale, c.height*scale), Image.LANCZOS)
    c = ImageEnhance.Contrast(c).enhance(1.2)
    c.save(f'crops/{name}.png')
    print(name, (x1,y1,x2,y2), c.size)
